messages:
maya: Heads-up — planned weekend minor deploy (v1.8.3) that includes a runtime kernel tweak and pinning fallback logic. Need a short statuspage + customer email snippet. Target window Saturday 02:00–03:00 UTC.

daniel: Thanks. Is this the change that pins older model variants on OOM fallback?

maya: Yes, exactly. We’re adding a last-resort pin to v1.7.x if the new quant path triggers memory pressure. Should be safe but want comms ready in case we need to roll customers to pinned variant.

sre_oncall: Can we keep a canary for 15m in eu-west-1 before global roll? If canary fails we abort and pin back.

denial: (typo) daniel: +1 to canary. Also please add a note about potential brief throttling while autoscaler rebalances.

deploy-bot: deploy started: release/v1.8.3 to eu-west-1 canary at 1729981160. CI: ✅, smoke tests: ✅

maya: Copy. Nidhi — can you draft a short statuspage blurb and email line-items we can use if we need to pin back? Keep it blunt and action-oriented.

nidhi: Drafting now. Suggest two variants: (A) routine maintenance successful, (B) fallback pin activated. Posting both snippets below.

nidhi: SNIPPET A (routine)
```
Scheduled maintenance: We performed a short maintenance window to deploy performance updates to the inference runtime. No customer impact observed. Services returned to normal at 02:12 UTC. If you notice any issues, contact support.
```

nidhi: SNIPPET B (fallback/pin)
```
Incident (fallback pin applied): During a scheduled deployment, we detected increased memory pressure for a subset of requests and temporarily pinned affected customers to a verified model variant to maintain availability. There was brief degradation for some high-memory workloads between 02:05–02:20 UTC. We are investigating the cause and will report back with follow-up actions.
```

maya: Good. Add note about billing: "No extra charge from fallback" for customer-facing language.

daniel: Ops ask: add a short internal timeline and rollback decision tree to the statuspage ops notes (internal only). Example: canary fail -> abort global -> pin -> notify customers.

ops-bot: Log: canary metrics uploaded to /ops/releases/1729981110/canary-metrics.json

deploy-bot: canary complete: metrics stable at 15m. proceeding to staged EU->NA roll. Next shard deploy scheduled at 1729981225.

sre_oncall: During staged roll please watch KV cache growth and tail latency. I’ll be on pager for the window.

maya: Final checklist for comms team: 1) Publish SNIPPET A after rollout completes (automated update to statuspage). 2) Keep SNIPPET B ready in draft. 3) Email template: short subject + 3 bullets. 4) Postmortem owner: daniel.

nidhi: Email template draft:
Subject: Maintenance update — short runtime deploy (v1.8.3)
Body: Hi — we performed a short maintenance window on DATE at TIME UTC to deploy performance improvements. No action required. If you were affected, we applied a temporary pinned model variant to maintain availability; our team is following up. Reply to this thread to reach support.

maya: Nice. If we need to escalate, call out SLA impact explicitly — but we expect none.

deploy-bot: global rollout complete at 1729981250. post-deploy smoke: ✅. No rollback performed.

maya: Okay — publishing SNIPPET A to statuspage now and scheduling the customer email for 03:00 UTC. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

daniel: Will start the brief internal timeline doc and link it in the postmortem.

sre_oncall: Marking window clear. I’ll keep runbook notes under the ops folder.

ops-bot: action: statuspage update posted at 1729981260 (SNIPPET A). email scheduled for 1729981400.
